title: Samsung unveils its new Odyssey lineup with QD-OLED panels and refresh rates up to 1,100 Hz
summary: The 2027 lineup includes IPS monitors at 1,100 Hz and QD-OLED at 720 Hz, setting a new speed standard for gaming.

title: Nvidia agrees to acquire Hugging Face for $12.9 billion to control the largest repository of open AI models
summary: The chipmaker expands its open AI strategy by acquiring the leading platform for collaborative models and datasets.

title: Rockstar shows 27 minutes of GTA 6 gameplay on PS5 with new interactions and improvements in combat and driving
summary: The video reveals unprecedented ambition in open-world detail, minigames, and physics, though a certain lack of fluidity is noticeable.

title: Google launches Gemini 3.5 Transcribe, a multilingual speech recognition model that corrects dictation errors
summary: The new API transcribes 85 languages in real time and automatically corrects stutters and repetitions.

title: Google introduces Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash: cheaper and more flexible AI video generation
summary: The model reduces costs and latency in synthetic video creation, opening the door to mass applications.

title: Hugging Face launches Microduck, an open-source duck robot for $399 to experiment with physical AI
summary: The device integrates sensors, actuators, and vision models so developers can create embodied agents.

title: Two alleged TeamPCP members arrested in Australia for hacking the supply chain of Mercor, OpenAI, and other companies
summary: The police operation links the group to attacks on talent providers and AI platforms, stealing credentials and code.

title: Bill Gates proposes taxing AI tokens and robots to fund jobs reserved for humans
summary: The Microsoft founder warns of imminent labor chaos and suggests automation taxes as a safety net.

title: AMD confirms its upcoming Zen 6 processors: Olympic Ridge for gaming and Medusa as APU, both on AM5 socket
summary: The official leak reveals hybrid core architecture and integrated RDNA 3.5 graphics for 2026.

title: Modders unlock experimental DLSS 5 hours after discovering its files in NBA 2K7 and test it in Control
summary: Nvidia's new upscaling version appears in an unannounced game and the community manages to activate it in current titles.

title: Microsoft will allow shutting down, restarting, and updating a Windows 11 PC from an Android phone
summary: The feature, already in testing, uses the Link to Windows app to manage remote power control of the computer.

title: A modder creates a 'PlayStation 3 Pro' with overclocking and Noctua cooling that improves performance in almost all games
summary: The v3 revision uses server heatsinks and 120 mm fans to stabilize the console at higher frequencies.

title: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and over 100 companies sign an open letter warning of imminent AI-powered cyberattacks against critical infrastructure
summary: The coalition urges governments and the private sector to coordinate defenses against the offensive use of autonomous agents.
